newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS accepts tendered Pacific shrs.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS accepts tendered Pacific shrs.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp said Monday it had accepted all of the common shares of Pacific Rehabilitation & Sports Medicine Inc tendered pursuant to its cash tender at $6.50 net per share.
Horizon/CMS said about 7.8 million shares, or 93.9 percent of Pacific Rehabilitation 's outstanding shares, were tendered.

Horizon/CMS also said it plans to effect a cash merger of a wholly owned subsidiary and Pacific Rehabilitation in order to acquire the remaining Pacific Rehabilitation shares at the same price as the tender offer.

Pacific Rehabilitation provides outpatient therapy services at 66 outpatient rehabilitation clinics in 10 states. Horizon/CMS said it offers post-acute healthcare services and long-term care services.
